name: SpraayBatch
description: Batch USDC payouts for AI agents — pay up to 200 recipients in one atomic transaction on Base. Gasless via CDP Paymaster (agents holding only USDC, zero ETH, can pay), non-custodial auto-wallet, per-agent budget caps.

walletKey.description: EVM wallet private key (0x + 64 hex). Optional — auto-generated and saved to ~/.spraay/.session if not set.

network.description: Base network for payments. Defaults to base-sepolia until you opt into mainnet.

enabled.description: Whether to sponsor gas so USDC-only agents can transact (needs paymasterUrl).

capUsd.description: Optional upper bound on sponsored gas spend (per period). Local enforcement is a future hook; the authoritative cap is your CDP dashboard paymaster policy.

paymasterUrl.description: CDP Paymaster & Bundler RPC URL (https://api.developer.coinbase.com/rpc/v1/base/<KEY>). When set and sponsorship is enabled, batch payouts run gasless via an ERC-4337 smart account. Also settable via CDP_PAYMASTER_URL env var.
